Woh pehla bite jab crispy waffle toot jaaye aur andar se almond ki richness baahar aaye... 🧇✨

Pune mein waffle ki baat ho toh The Waffy Tales ek naam hai jo genuinely alag hai. Nagar Road, Lohegaon — ek chhoti si stall, badi badi feelings.

Humne try kiya Almond Affair — aur naam bilkul sahi hai. Crispy golden waffle, topped with almond goodness, perfectly balanced sweetness. Na zyada heavy, na kam satisfying. Ek cheez toh pakka — aap ek se zyada order karoge. 😤

Menu mein options dekho — Dark Delight, Biscoff, KitKat Nutella, Red Velvet... literally har mood ke liye ek waffle hai. 🤎

📍 The Waffy Tales, Nagar Road, Sangamwadi, Lohegaon, Pune
💰 Starts at ₹80 onwards
🕐 Evening stall — best time to visit at golden hour 🌇

👇 Waffle lovers — kaun sa flavour try karoge? Almond Affair ya Biscoff? Comment mein batao! 🧇

Jab Kolhapuri gravy naan ke saath mile... woh pehla bite aag lagata hai — aur phir bhi aap ek aur piece tod lete ho. 🔥🍞
Pune ke Charholi mein ek chhupa hua gem hai — Hotel Swaraj Family Restaurant. Bahar se simple lagta hai, andar se asli Maharashtrian ghar ka khaana milta hai.

Humne try kiya Chicken Kolhapuri — woh deep red, kala masala-based gravy jo sirf Kolhapur ki style mein banti hai. Thick, bold, spicy — bilkul waise jaisi honi chahiye. Aur saath mein Butter Naan — soft, slightly crisp edges, ghee ki khushboo. Dono ka combo? Seedha dil pe laga. 🧡

Yeh woh jagah hai jo food lovers ko pata hoti hai, tourists ko nahi. Aur humne tumhare liye dhundh li. 😤

📍 Hotel Swaraj Family Restaurant, Kotwal Wadi, Charholi Budruk, Charholi, Pune
🌶️ Spice level: Teen taarein ⭐⭐⭐ — real Kolhapuri heat

💰 Avg: ₹300–500 per person (approximate — confirm on visit)
🍽️ Best for: Family dinner, late night hunger

Woh pehla modak ka bite — naram outer, andar meethi nariyal-gur ki filling... aur ek second ke liye lagta hai Bappa khud aashirwad de rahe hain. 🙏🤍

Pune mein paramparik, ukadiche modak dhundhna mushkil hota ja raha hai — sab jagah chocolate aur fusion mil raha hai. Par JyozMo ne yeh purani recipe ko zinda rakha hai.

Yahan ka Ukadiche Modak — steamed, soft, traditional — bilkul waise jaisa nani ya aai banati thi. Koi shortcut nahi, koi artificial flavour nahi. Bas asli swaad.
Aur haan — chocolate aur other variants bhi hain for those who like a twist. 😄

📍 JyozMo, Shop No. 6, Alankar Society, Dabhade Wasti, Kalajewadi, Charholi Budruk, Pune
🕐 Evening hours

Woh pehla bite jab roll ka masala aur cheese saath mein mile... bas yahin toh life hai. 🌯🔥
Pune mein rolls ki baat ho aur Good Food Kitchen ka naam na aaye — aisa ho hi nahi sakta.
Yeh Chicken Tikka Roll is seriously underrated. Soft rumali-style roti, juicy tikka filling, tangy chutney, aur upar se shredded cheese ka tarka — ek cheez toh poori tarah pakad leti hai, woh hai iska smoky aftertaste. Ek roll mein poora mood set ho jaata hai. 😤❤️

📍 Good Food Kitchen, Laxmi Society, Model Colony, Shivajinagar, Pune
💰 Avg: ₹120–150 per roll
⏰ Evening tak milta hai — jaldi pohoncho, bik jaate hain!

Shivajinagar mein ek shaam... jab tandoor ki khushboo aur mural ki vibe saath mein mile. 🍗✨

Sach batayein — Eden Court mein ghuste hi ek cheez feel hoti hai: "yaar, yeh alag hai."

Smoky, perfectly charred Tandoori Chicken — woh outer crisp aur andar juicy texture jo sirf sahi tandoor mein milti hai. Aur saath mein jo mocktails aaye — bilkul photogenic, aur taste mein bhi koi compromise nahi. 🍹

Ambience ki baat karein toh — woh mural dekh ke aap khud ruk jaoge. Evenings mein yeh jagah ek alag hi mood mein hoti hai. Date night ho, friends gang ho, ya akele bhi — sab fit baithta hai.

📍 Eden Court Restaurant & Bar, Shivajinagar, Pune
💰 Avg: ₹700–900 per person
⏰ 10 AM – 12 AM (late night bhi open! 🌙)

Woh pehla chamach jab rasmalai toot jaaye aur woh meethi, kesar-infused rabdi andar se baahar aaye... 😮‍💨🤍

Yaar, yeh ek aisa mithai hai jo kisi bhi mood ko theek kar deti hai.
Bikaner Sweets ka yeh Rasmalai — naram, soft gulab jamun-style balls, soaked deeply in thick saffron-flavoured milk rabdi. Na zyada meetha, na kam. Bilkul balance mein. Aur woh golden colour dekh ke hi mann bhar jaata hai. 🌼

Charholi Budruk mein yeh ek trusted local sweet shop hai — ghar jaisa swaad, bina kisi drama ke.

📍 Bikaner Sweets, Charoli BK, Wadmukhwadi Rd, Pune
🕐 Daytime best — fresh stock rehta hai
💰 Affordable — mithai per piece rates

👇 Sweet lover ho toh batao — Rasmalai ya Gulab Jamun? Ek hi choose karna ho toh? 🍮

Best dates aren't fancy — they are flavourful. 😉🌶️🍹

Kya zaroorat hai candlelight dinner ki, jab ek plate Ragda Chaat aur ek glass Falooda saath mein ho?

Yeh wala combo actually insane hai — pehle Ragda Chaat ki tangy, spicy, masaledar hit... aur uske baad Falooda ki sweet, creamy, refreshing finish. Do opposite flavours, ek perfect evening. ❤️
Tanish O2 at Charholi is giving serious local hangout vibes — nothing pretentious, just good food and good company.

Iss jagah ka ek simple formula hai: asli swaad + sasti keemat + dil khush. 🫶

📍 Tanish O2, Charoli BK, Pune
🍽️ Must try: Ragda Chaat + Falooda combo
💰 Budget-friendly — street food prices
⏰ Evening hours best hain
